2607.10745.title: The First ChineseBabyLM Challenge: training data-efficient and cognitively plausible language models for Chinese
2607.10745.paper_summary: This paper describes the first ChineseBabyLM challenge, which will be held in the 2026 NLPCC conference. The challenge calls for researchers to train language models from scratch with 100 million Chinese tokens and evaluates the models on 3 tracks of tasks: NLU, cognitive alignment and Hanzi knowledge. There is no restriction on tokenizer, model architecture and the number of training epochs. Details of the challenge can be found in https://chinese-babylm.github.io/.
2607.10745.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文描述了第一次的ChineseBabyLM挑戰賽，將於2026年NLPCC會議上舉行。這項挑戰邀請研究人員從零開始訓練語言模型，使用1億個中文標記，並在三個任務的軌道上評估模型：自然語言理解（NLU）、認知對齊和漢字知識。對於分詞器、模型架構和訓練輪次沒有任何限制。挑戰的詳細信息可以在https://chinese-babylm.github.io/找到。
